```{r}
}
```


```{r, fig.asp = 1, fig.width = 7}
get_metadata_from_so(so) %>% 
    dplyr::select(cell, umap_1, umap_2, all_of(str_subset(colnames(.), "RNA_snn_res."))) %>% 
    pivot_longer(cols = all_of(str_subset(colnames(.), "RNA_snn_res.")), 
                 names_to = "clustering", 
                 values_to = "cluster") %>% 
    plot_umap(x = umap_1, 
              y = umap_2, 
              color_str = "cluster", 
              pointsize = 3.1, 
              label = TRUE, label_groups = "clustering") + 
    facet_wrap(~clustering, ncol = 3)
```

# Assign clusters

```{r}
cluster_ann_df <- readxl::read_excel(file.path(results_dir, "cluster_annotations.xlsx")) %>% 
    tidyr::fill(Subset, clustering) %>% 
    filter(Subset == "so_filterRNA200mito10_subsettumor.rds") %>% 
    filter(clustering == "RNA_snn_res.0.1") %>% 
    mutate(cluster_ID_name = paste0(cluster, ": ", cluster_ID))

cluster_key <-
    cluster_ann_df$cluster_ID_name %>% set_names(cluster_ann_df$cluster)
cluster_grouped_key <-
    cluster_ann_df$cluster_ID_grouped %>% set_names(cluster_ann_df$cluster)

palette_cluster <- cluster_ann_df$color %>% set_names(cluster_ann_df$cluster_ID_name)

cluster_ID_name_ordered <- cluster_ann_df %>% 
    arrange(cluster_ID_grouped) %>% 
    .$cluster_ID_name
```

```{r}
cell_type_metadata <- get_metadata_from_so(so, metadata = "RNA_snn_res.0.1", reduction = NULL) %>%
    mutate(clusters = cluster_key[as.character(RNA_snn_res.0.1)]) %>% 
    select(-RNA_snn_res.0.1) %>% 
    column_to_rownames("cell")
so <- AddMetaData(so, metadata = cell_type_metadata)
```


```{r}
get_metadata_from_so(so) %>%
  plot_umap(
    x = umap_1, y = umap_2, 
    color_str = "clusters",
    pointsize = 5.1
  ) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = palette_cluster)
```

# Dot plot marker

```{r}
genes <- c(
    "Cd74", "Lyz2", # Myeloid doublets
    "Efna1", "Atf4", "Kdelr3", # Stressed
    "Tnfaip2",  # Inflammatory
    "Mki67", "Stmn1", "Polq", "Ankle1"  # Prolif
    # "Hif1a", "Vim", # Hypoxic
    # "Ifit1", "Isg15", # IFN-sensing
)

dotplot_df <-
    get_metadata_from_so(so,
                         metadata = "clusters",
                         genes = genes,
                         reduction = NULL) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = 3:ncol(.),
                 names_to = "gene",
                 values_to = "expr") %>%
    mutate(clusters = factor(clusters, levels = rev(cluster_ID_name_ordered))) %>%
    mutate(gene = factor(gene, levels = genes)) %>% 
    group_by(gene) %>%
    mutate(scaled_expr = as.vector(scale(expr))) %>%
    group_by(clusters, gene) %>%
    summarise(mean_scaled_expr = mean(expr)) 
dotplot_df %>% 
    ggplot() +
    aes(gene, clusters) +
    geom_point(aes(size = mean_scaled_expr, color = mean_scaled_expr)) + 
    labs(caption = "color and size are scaled mean expression; cell types not shown in any particular order here") + 
    scale_color_viridis(limits = c(NA, 3) ,oob = scales::squish) + 
    remove_spines() + 
    theme(panel.background = element_rect(color = "black"), 
          axis.title = element_blank(), 
          legend.position = "none", 
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5), 
          axis.text.y = ggtext::element_markdown())
```

# How are our groups distributed

```{r, fig.asp = 2, fig.width = 3}
get_metadata_from_so(so) %>% 
    calculate_proportion(clusters, group) %>% 
    plot_proportion(fill = clusters) + 
    labs(y = "Freq") + 
    scale_fill_manual(values = palette_cluster) 
```

# DGE CD40 vs isotype in B2mKO

```{r}
so_b2m <- subset(so %>% set_idents("genotype"), ident = "B2m KO")
# so_b2m
```

```{r}
dge_treatment_df <- run_or_readRDS(
    file.path(
        results_dir, 
        "so_filterRNA200mito10_subsettumor_subsetb2m_dge.cd40.v.isotype.rds"
    ), 
    function() {FindMarkers(so_b2m %>% set_idents("treatment"), 
                            ident.1 = "CD40 agonist", 
                            logfc.threshold = 1e-8, 
                            min.pct = 1e-8)}
)
```

```{r}
dge_treatment_df_filtered <- dge_treatment_df %>% 
  as_tibble(rownames = "gene") %>% 
  filter(pct.1 > 0.1) %>% 
  filter(pct.2 > 0.1) %>% 
  filter(abs(avg_log2FC) > 0.1) 
dge_treatment_df_filtered %>% 
  ggplot() + 
  aes(avg_log2FC, -log10(p_val_adj)) + 
  geom_scattermore(pointsize = 3.1) + 
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = gene, color = avg_log2FC > 0), 
                  data = ~..1 %>% filter(
                    gene %in% c("Ifi27", "H2-D1", "Gapdh", 
                                "Ifitm3", "Cdk2", "Isg15", 
                                "Top2b", "Hif1a", "B2m")
                  ), 
                  max.overlaps = Inf) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = c("red", "blue"))
  
```


```{r}
dge_df <- dge_treatment_df %>% 
  as_tibble(rownames = "gene") %>% 
  mutate(signed_log_pvalue = ifelse(avg_log2FC > 0, -log10(p_val), log10(p_val))) %>% 
  arrange(desc(signed_log_pvalue))
dge_df %>% write_csv(file.path(results_dir, "dge_tumor_b2m_cd40.v.isotype.csv"))

rank_vec <- dge_df %>% 
  mutate(rank = row_number()) %>% 
  {set_names(.$signed_log_pvalue, .$gene)}
```

```{r, message = FALSE}
death_signature_dir <- here("data", "signatures", "death_signatures")
death_sig_list <- list.files(death_signature_dir) %>% 
  str_subset(".gmt") %>% 
  set_names() %>% 
  map(~{
    data <- read_tsv(file.path(death_signature_dir, ..1), col_names = F)
    return(pivot_longer(data, cols = 3:ncol(data))$value)
  }) 
```

```{r}
res <- fgsea(death_sig_list, rank_vec)
res_df <- tibble(res) %>% 
  arrange(desc(NES))
```

```{r, eval = F}
write_csv(res_df, file.path(results_dir, "gsea_tumor_b2m_cd40.v.isotype.csv"))
```


```{r}
res_df %>% 
  ggplot() + 
  aes(fct_reorder(pathway, NES), NES, color = pval < 0.05) + 
  geom_point() + 
  geom_segment(aes(y = 0, yend = NES)) + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = c("grey", "black")) + 
  coord_flip()
```

```{r}
Rsc::get_leading_edge_df(rank_vec, death_sig_list$HALLMARK_INTERFERON_ALPHA_RESPONSE.v2026.1.Mm.gmt) %>%
  Rsc::plot_gsea_curve("Hallmark IFNa response")

Rsc::get_leading_edge_df(rank_vec, death_sig_list$GOBP_RESPONSE_TO_TYPE_I_INTERFERON.v2026.1.Mm.gmt) %>%
  Rsc::plot_gsea_curve("GOBP Type I IFN")

Rsc::get_leading_edge_df(rank_vec, death_sig_list$REACTOME_APOPTOSIS.v2026.1.Mm.gmt) %>%
  Rsc::plot_gsea_curve("Reactome Apoptosis")

Rsc::get_leading_edge_df(rank_vec, death_sig_list$GOBP_TRAIL_ACTIVATED_APOPTOTIC_SIGNALING_PATHWAY.v2026.1.Mm.gmt) %>%
  Rsc::plot_gsea_curve("GOBP_TRAIL_ACTIVATED_APOPTOTIC")
```
